{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for the QA orders
print("\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nRefunded orders:", df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
# First, strip commas and convert to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
completed_cleaned = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_numeric'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_cleaned['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f"\nMean revenue of completed orders (after cleaning): {mean_revenue}")

# Output the final value
mean_revenue"}
